children: Dubai, United Arab Emirates, November 19th, 2026, Chainwire
Bybit, the New Financial Platform trusted by more than 80 million users worldwide, today announced its participation as Title Partner and Official Exchange Partner of
Proof of Talk in Abu Dhabi 2026
, taking place on December 3 and 4 at Louvre Abu Dhabi.
As part of the summit's programme, three Bybit executives will join discussions on the evolving financial landscape:
Ben Zhou, Co-founder and CEO of Bybit
, will share perspectives on the evolution of digital asset exchanges into integrated financial platforms and the convergence of traditional and digital finance.
Sean Ballard, Head of Derivatives and Institutional Business at Bybit
, will contribute insights on institutional liquidity, derivatives markets and trading infrastructure.
Derek Dai, MENA Country Manager at Bybit
, will share regional insights on the future of finance, digital asset adoption and financial development across MENA.
Beyond the main summit, Bybit will also sponsor the
Proof of Talk: Golf Prelude
on December 2, bringing together a select group of founders, investors and industry leaders for an afternoon of networking ahead of the conference.

Hosted at Louvre Abu Dhabi, Proof of Talk marks its inaugural Gulf edition following four editions at the Louvre Palace in Paris. Organised by X Ventures, the invitation-only executive summit brings together senior decision-makers, institutional investors, financial leaders and technology innovators for discussions spanning capital, digital assets and artificial intelligence.

Bybit's participation builds on its growing presence in the UAE and its continued engagement with the country's regulatory framework. The company holds a full Virtual Asset Platform Operator Licence from the UAE Securities and Commodities Authority (SCA). In October 2026, Bybit also secured a Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) licence from Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) for exchange services.

These milestones reflect Bybit's commitment to regulatory compliance and the responsible development of digital asset markets. The company sees the UAE as an important hub for connecting global financial opportunities with regional innovation, talent and institutional participation.

Through its partnership with Proof of Talk Abu Dhabi, Bybit looks forward to contributing to industry dialogue, strengthening relationships with regional and global stakeholders, and supporting the continued growth of the UAE as a centre for digital asset and financial innovation.
